about: Static manifest for the documentation version selector. Hand-maintained, committed to the repository, and read at authoring time -- never fetched at runtime and never resolved through the GitHub API. tools/check_site.py verifies that every entry here resolves and that every directory under site/v/ appears here.

versions.label: development
